items.name: PeruRoad Climate: WhatsApp alerts for 7 days
items.description: One-time payment for WhatsApp alerts on the PE-22 stretch the driver explicitly selected. The pass expires 168 hours after the original WhatsApp request, without renewal or another charge. Input request_id is the opaque request identifier created after typed ACTIVAR consent; no phone number is sent to Qatom. Alerts begin only after a verified settled sale. Covers SUTRAN changes, explicitly unconfirmed community reports and estimated climate exposure; no safety guarantee. STOP or BAJA cancels delivery. Read the free plan at /api/subscriptions/plan and /llms.txt for input and response conventions. Expired, cancelled or already-used requests do not grant access; contact the seller if payment settled without activation.

request_id.description: Opaque weekly-alert request ID issued by the PeruRoad WhatsApp flow after explicit typed consent. The existing request pins the route, recipient, price and expiry; none are buyer inputs.
